student_summary.headline: Lancaster A100
student_summary.subheadline: Medicine and Surgery MBChB, Standard Entry, 5 years
student_summary.status_message: This representative Home standard applicant meets the implemented minimum gates. UCAT 1950 is 30 points above the published 2026-entry Home threshold of 1920, producing a strong-choice ApplySmart interpretation of historical data. It is not a current 2027 cut-off, an official Lancaster category or an interview guarantee.
key_points: Eight represented GCSEs produce 14 Lancaster points, above the 13-point minimum.
English Language and Mathematics are at grade 6, and Biology, Chemistry and Physics are at grade 7.
Predicted AAB includes two of Biology, Chemistry and Psychology, so the Stage 1 academic gate is met.
UCAT is present and SJT Band 2 passes the Band 1-3 gate.
UCAT 1950 is compared with the 2026-entry Home standard threshold of 1920.

Historical threshold comparisons may change each admissions cycle depending on applicant competition and interview capacity. Historical figures are guidance only, not a current cut-off, and do not guarantee an interview.
